translations.warning_title: WARNING — COLLISION AND PRINTER DAMAGE RISK
translations.warning_body: Non-planar toolpaths can cause print head collisions, damage your printer and ruin the part. Use at your own risk. Check clearances and supervise the entire print. Never leave the printer unattended.
translations.warning_preview: Send at your own risk. Read and acknowledge the yellow warning before sending the file.
translations.warning_bead: Some beads are below the profile minimum layer height. Recalculate the toolpath before sending.
translations.warning_send: Print head clearance, deposition and transitions may not be validated for your printer. By continuing, you accept the risks of this file.
